'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Jake Nelson LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jake Nelson]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''Just Some Simple Tricks and Nonsense'''. No username. Typed. LIGHT checked. L1 writes Quiet Mining Colony/Independent Operation; entered as the objective Quiet Mining Colony (Independent Operation is the back, not a second card). L37 typed path of least resisance. L40–41 Luke w/ Lightsaber → Luke With Lightsaber. L51 kalfalnclndros → Kal'Falnl C'ndros. Shield boxes are empty. Shields 1, 2, and 4 have (V) typed in the name, so those three are (V).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Quiet Mining Colony]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
